title: End-to-end nonprofit kit build and independent second-worker check
setup: Recorded Eranos request run (weekly volunteer shift-schedule kit) on Muse Spark 1.3 with two separate worker keys
notes: Worker 1 drafted the kit, its 8 unit tests and its README in 207.27 seconds (25 model calls).
Worker 2, holding a different key, ran all 8 unit tests and checked every publication rule in 82.73 seconds (14 model calls) with 0 rule violations.
Public test work used muse-spark-1.3-contributor; live requests use the standard tier.
